title: Poly(lactic acid) nanoplastics through laser ablation: establishing a reference model for mimicking biobased nanoplastics in aquatic environments
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,2395-2406
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00891J, Paper
Open Access

Malavika Manju Sudheer, Arezou Fazli, Stefania Sganga, Nicola Tirelli, Riccardo Carzino, Marina Veronesi, Kirill Khabarov, Athanassia Athanassiou, Despina Fragouli
In response to the limited environmentally relevant biobased nanoplastic models, the formation of poly(lactic acid) nanoplastics with comparable properties to the ones deriving from the environmental ageing of poly(lactic acid) debris, is presented.
